usedFor: Heartbeat holds community members and events, and Google Sheets keeps the roster through “Update Spreadsheet Row”.

bestTemplate.name: “Course completed” in Heartbeat, then “Update Spreadsheet Row” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: A finished course is a status change, so the member's row can show completion without manual edits.

watchOut: “Update Spreadsheet Row” edits an existing row, so a “New User” in Heartbeat needs a row added first.
